body:
nn.prn is real, working, but forward-only activation functions for a gpt2-alpine-c port -- no conv2d/conv2d-transpose/batchnorm/autodiff/optimizer/loss/image-loading exist. Named the real, decisive fork (hand-derived backward passes per op, recommended, vs. full autodiff, needs generic dispatch VS0 doesn't have) and a 7-phase, dependency-ordered plan (Conv2D via im2col+matmul, ConvTranspose2D, BatchNorm2D forward, backward passes, Adam+BCE, training loop, image loading last). Scoping only. docs/DCGAN_PRIMITIVES_NORTHSTAR.md, registered in golden-docs-index. Commit b013f11.

⚓ ☃
title: S210-01: audited nn.prn's real scope, wrote a real phased DCGAN plan
